classification.difficultyReason: Build the spent fraction from three expenses, identify the leftover fraction and reverse that fraction of income to recover the whole without intermediate prompts.

content.prompt: Each month, a family spends $\frac{5}{12}$ of its income on food, $\frac{1}{3}$ on housing and $\frac{1}{24}$ on transport. If there is $\$960$ left over, calculate the family’s income.

answer.worked:
The fraction of income spent is
$$\begin{align*}\frac{5}{12}+\frac{1}{3}+\frac{1}{24}&=\frac{10+8+1}{24}\\\frac{5}{12}+\frac{1}{3}+\frac{1}{24}&=\frac{19}{24}.\end{align*}$$
The fraction left over is
$$1-\frac{19}{24}=\frac{5}{24}.$$
Since $\frac{5}{24}$ of the income is $\$960$, $\frac{1}{24}$ of the income is
$$960\div5=192.$$
The family’s monthly income is
$$24\times\$192=\$4608.$$
